metadataRaw.title: One Move for INSTANT Hip Pain Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the 90-90 exercise, one of the best moves for instant hip pain relief.

The 90-90 is a great way to help target the main muscles that cause hip pain. Also, it helps improve flexibility by putting the hip into external and internal rotation.

Let us know how it works for you!
